# ArcAI

> ArcAI (Ask, Reflect, Create) is a free multimodal AI assistant by Win The Night Productions. Natural voice conversations, Arc Imagix image generation, code canvas, writing tools, music player and living memory in one app.

Arc Matrix™ powers ArcAI chat, code, writing and analysis. The model picker offers Auto, Ava (fast & agile), Maya (everyday powerhouse) and River (deep reasoning); Auto starts with Ava and steps up for clearly harder requests. Natural, interruptible voice conversations are powered by Voxi. Free accounts get 3 voice sessions per UTC day, up to 5 minutes each; Boost subscribers and administrators get unlimited voice sessions up to 2 hours each. Living memory, Deep Search, web search, file uploads, document analysis, canvases, shared chats, code generation and one-tap publishing are also included.

Free accounts can generate or edit up to 3 image outputs total with Arc Imagix. Boost subscribers and administrators have unlimited image generation and precision Arc Imagix Edit tools.

Published code creations use the `*.froydingermedia.online` domain and stay live until their owner unpublishes them.
